mapper.select: SELECT p.spu_id, p.spu_name, p.category_id, p.main_image, p.description, p.sales, MAX(k.price) AS price FROM (SELECT * FROM product_spu ORDER BY spu_id LIMIT #{pageStart},#{pageSize}) p LEFT JOIN product_sku k ON p.spu_id = k.spu_id GROUP BY p.spu_id, p.spu_name, p.category_id, p.main_image, p.sales
select p.spu_id, p.spu_name, p.category_id, p.main_image, p.description, p.sales from product_spu p where p.spu_id = #{spuId};
select k.* from product_sku k where k.spu_id = #{spuId};
